article.en: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
article.zh: 我们的邻居查尔斯·艾利森船长明天就要从朴次茅斯启航了。

article.en: We shall meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
